projects.title: Snaking Clones v0.3
projects.instructions:
You have probably all seen my Terraria project I've been working on for a 3 months now. Next up I'm needing to add some worm type AI enemies, but to do this I needed an efficient way of creating a worm/snake body that follows its head without the need to add more lists of positions into an already very large project! And so... this little test project has come into being...

Of course is always the way when you are having fun, I then tried introducing a few constraints to the snake's body such that it would attempt to unfurl a little... and the result is really funny especially as it jiggles around quite a bit :) - So thought I would share it with you!

Change Log
v0.3 - Choice of worm types :)
v0.2 - Replaced skin with a dragon - Do you like?
v0.1 - Initial Worm Scratch Cat Sprite

projects.title: Ant collective learning
projects.description:
Collective learning results from simple ant rules:

If ant finds food it bites & leaves pheromone (red). 

If ant detects pheromone, it turns very little. If ant doesn't detect pheromone, it turns at a wider angle.  

Ants only leave pheromone for a limited time after eating. Some pheromone wears out as ants travel over it. Eating food and wearing out pheromone are both negative feedback mechanisms that lead to ants eventually abandoning the march towards food.  

Based on research I read. 

I did a version of this model about two years ago, but this one looks better with green grass and bread.

See also ants following a line of pheromone: https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/520597948/

projects.instructions:
yay this is the full game I guess :)

Arrow/WASD Keys to Move
C/L to Sprint
X/M to Interact with stuff (as well as dash)
Space to Jump (mainly over the thorny bushes)

MANUAL:
There isn't any kind of guide in game so this is your main manual.
There are sometimes barricades in the end of a room, use your dash to break through it
Gates must have all 3 buttons in the room it's in pressed to destroy it.

Just use the Ball in the Saferooms, it gives you a hint on what to do for entities you encounter in that level.

Macrocosm (The Planet): it's the Carnation of this game, just keep going until you find a purple tinted room, and hide in the Holes. (You are also safe while in SafeRooms, and you hide in holes using X/M)

Haste (The Cloud): Just Simply gives a limited amount of time to stay in a room, or else you get damaged.

Corral (The Jellyfish): blocks the entryway, get close enough to it for it to attack, you can pass through if you dodge it.

Syllabary (The Letter-Train): The Slugfish ripoff, just stay out of the middle when it arrives and you're good. (You're also safe from it while in Saferooms)

Discern (The Rock): Stop sprinting when in it's aura, or you could risk getting damaged.

Leviathan (The Butterfly): don't touch the hooks, or else you risk dying.

Paralyze (The Snowflake): When opening it's eyes, don't move. click on Paralyze to get rid of it.
